name: app-text-field
title: AppTextField

public_api.constructor:
AppTextField({
  required String label,
  String? hint,
  String? helperText,
  String? errorText,
  IconData? prefixIcon,
  Widget? suffixIcon,
  bool obscureText = false,
  TextInputType? keyboardType,
  TextInputAction? textInputAction,
  TextEditingController? controller,
  ValueChanged<String>? onChanged,
  ValueChanged<String>? onSubmitted,
  FormFieldValidator<String>? validator,
  bool isMultiline = false,
  bool isEnabled = true,
})

conventions_reminder: All colors/spacings/radii/durations via tokens — no hardcoded values
Focus states: primary color border with subtle primary tint shadow
Error states: error color border with error tint shadow
Double quotes on all string literals
Top-of-file doc comment explaining purpose + state behavior
acceptance_criteria: Default content padding uses Spacing.space_md horizontal, Spacing.space_sm vertical
completion_summary: Implemented AppTextField widget as StatelessWidget wrapping TextFormField with all specified props: label, hint, helperText, errorText, prefixIcon (IconData), suffixIcon (Widget), obscureText, keyboardType, textInputAction, controller, onChanged, onSubmitted, validator, isMultiline, isEnabled, maxLines, autofocus. isMultiline sets maxLines:null, minLines:3, TextInputType.multiline. Enabled=false maps to TextFormField enabled param. Decoration (border/padding/fill) comes from theme. Double quotes, no emojis. flutter analyze: 0 issues.
